name: Matilda
family: Rescued with Orcca, Fabio, Paul, Hershey, Bob, Frankie, Flake, Bukkleh and Bettyboo
summary: Spayed, fully vaccinated and dewormed. A calm Persian girl, about 3 years old.
story:
Matilda belonged to a Ukrainian woman who had around 20 cats. When she was taken away by the police over her residency papers, her cats were left behind, and the building guard wanted to throw them all out on the street. Some of them were blind.

We rescued all of them at once, and Matilda was one of them. She came with Orcca, Fabio, Paul, Hershey, Bob, Frankie, Flake, Bukkleh and Bettyboo.

Today Matilda is about 3 years old, spayed, fully vaccinated and dewormed. She lives with other cats and is ready for a loving home of her own.
